Title: Jira connector for Umbraco Automate
Description: Create Jira Cloud issues, add comments and move issues from Umbraco Automate, and start automations from signed Jira webhooks. Credentials stay in configuration, never in automations.

AuthorDetails.Description: Umbraco developer and community package author.
